description: Zuma Resources Limited, formerly Bilal Fibres Limited, is a Pakistan Stock Exchange-listed company that describes its purpose as connecting local capital with global opportunities. Its stated projects are a global marketplace for eSIMs and a set of AI agents for marketing, support, assistance and productivity. It has a wholly owned UK subsidiary, Zuma Global Ltd.
headOffice: Building 90/50, 4th Floor, Block B, Broadway Commercial, Phase 8, D.H.A., Lahore, Pakistan
